cta.bannerSubtitle: Download Neat and start organizing, cleaning, and compressing your photos and videos today.
hero.title: Your Media, Organized
hero.subtitle: Browse, clean up, and compress your photos and videos — all on your device. Neat keeps your library tidy and your privacy intact.
features.organize.title: Your Media, Organized
features.organize.description: Browse all your photos and videos in one place. Sort by date, size, resolution, or duration. Filter by file size to find what takes up the most space.
features.organize.item1: Sort by date, size, resolution & duration
features.organize.item2: Filter by file size and compression status
features.organize.item3: Instant size calculations with smart caching
features.cleanup.title: Select & Clean Up
features.cleanup.description: Drag to select multiple items at once. Batch delete what you don't need. Find your largest files instantly with smart sorting and filtering.
features.cleanup.item2: Batch delete to free up space fast
features.compress.title: Compress & Save Space
features.compress.description: Reduce file sizes with adjustable quality presets. Preview before and after. Save as a copy or replace the original — you're in control.
features.compress.item1: Three quality presets: Max savings, Balanced, Best quality
features.compress.item3: Replace original or save as a copy
features.privacy.title: Your Privacy, Protected
features.privacy.description: All your photos and videos are processed entirely on your device. Nothing is ever uploaded to any server. Your media stays private — always.
features.privacy.item2: No accounts, no sign-ups, no tracking
highlights.title: And More
highlights.icloud.title: iCloud Ready
highlights.icloud.description: Works seamlessly with iCloud Photos. Download, preview, and compress cloud-stored media right from the app.
highlights.languages.title: 15 Languages
highlights.languages.description: Fully localized in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Russian, and more.
highlights.accessibility.title: Accessible
highlights.accessibility.description: Full VoiceOver support, semantic labels, and reduced motion settings. Designed for everyone.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Neat is designed with your privacy as a top priority. This policy explains how the app handles your data.
privacy.section1.title: Data Collection
privacy.section1.content: Neat does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. The app operates entirely on your device.
privacy.section2.title: Photo Library Access
privacy.section2.content: Neat requests access to your photo library through Apple's Photos framework to browse, preview, compress, and delete media. This data never leaves your device.
privacy.section3.title: Network Usage
privacy.section3.content: Neat does not connect to any external servers. The only network activity occurs when downloading iCloud-stored photos or videos to your device through Apple's system frameworks.
privacy.section4.title: Analytics & Tracking
privacy.section4.content: Neat does not use any analytics services, crash reporters, or tracking tools. No usage data is collected or shared with third parties.
privacy.section5.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.section5.content: Neat does not integrate with any third-party services or SDKs that collect user data.
privacy.section6.title: Changes to This Policy
privacy.section6.content: If this privacy policy is updated, changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.
privacy.section7.title: Contact
privacy.section7.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on our GitHub repository.
